override the matching lowercase key in `defaults`, with values coerced to the
type of the default (int, float, bool, str). Currently overrides are ignored.

arguments.summary: Fixed `load_config` in `cfg/loader.py` to properly apply environment overrides. The function now iterates over `env` keys prefixed with `APP_`, strips the prefix, lowercases the key, and coerces the string value to the type of the existing default (int, float, bool, str) before overriding. Added a `_coerce` helper for type coercion. The existing test now passes.
